summary: # git > Distributed version control system. > Some subcommands such as `commit`, `add`, `branch`, `switch`, `push`, etc. have their own usage documentation. > More information: <https://git-scm.com/docs/git>. - Create an empty Git repository: `git init` - Clone a remote Git repository from the internet: `git clone {{https://example.com/repo.git}}` - View the status of the local repository: `git status`
